text: They are holy readers who grasp the meaning of the scriptures and let go of the language, just like enjoying the juice from the sugarcane and letting go of the pipi.
Knowing yourself through constant introspection is your true self.
For those who want to travel on the path of knowledge, the ignorant are like meshes and create obstacles.
Just as if a jewel is given to a madman, he will not benefit from it.
Body lives by food and mind lives by qualities.
The mind, along with the senses, informs the living things. A living being is ignorant and experiences the joys and sorrows of that subject with pride.
Seeking small pleasures, the living being is faced with endless hardships due to ignorance.
Darkness to the outer eyes disappears due to the sensation. The darkness before the eyes of the mind is dispelled by enlightenment.
Bathing is necessary for body purification, knowledge is necessary for body (Jivatma) purification.
In one birth, the entry of the soul into the body is one time and the exit is also the same time.
The mode of birth of living bodies on earth is same for all. But there are only four ways to die.
Experiencing karma for the soul is exhausting, but egoism earns more karma.
Arrogance is caused by ignorance, and Agamikarma is caused by ego.
Just as the physical disease that has consumed holy medicine is gone, so the karmic disease is going to go away from the living being who has acquired pure knowledge.
Medicine without health, teaching without self-knowledge is futile.
The living being is tormenting by the weapons of Kama, Krodha, Lobha, Moha and Madha Matsaram.
A living being who is in the darkness of ignorance in the house of body can know himself only if he lights the lamp of knowledge.
Ignorance does not disappear until pride is removed. Ignorance is not self-realization.
The bodies formed by the Panchabhutas are destroyed by the Panchabhutas.
What is the use of being jealous that I am not like that when I look at those who are weighed down with Ashta Aishwarya? The pious fruit they have done in previous births is due to their condition.
The soul in the body is like a drop of water in the vast ocean.
God prefers emotional worship to external worship.
Effect of food ingredients does not change the quality effects. But due to the effect of guna, you will desire to eat those foods.
A fish is happy only from its native water, and the mind is happy only from its native soul.
The true brahma yoga is to become free from desires.
All ostentatious worships contribute to ignorance. But cannot provide self.
Dishes that have been washed, food that has been washed, and knowledge that has been given in vessels will bear pure fruit.
Righteousness and justice contribute to external advancement, knowledge and righteousness contribute to self-advancement.
Do not think that Maya is outside. It is in you. Know that delusion is not outside but in your head.
Take control of your mind that moves at unlimited speed and understand what the soul is.
Religions and castes are created by human beings but not created by Mahatmas.
The sense of the body is magic. Dehi Bhava is divine wisdom.
Jagadguru is the one who teaches the science of harmony of all beings.
To think of knowledge in the guise of education, and to dream of mirages are one and the same.
Karma causes the qualities, qualities cause the mind, and the mind causes the body to move. If you don't know that, you are ignorant.
Where is the ability to know the truth in the intoxication of external things?
Karma does not go away even if the hindrances stop the wandering mind and grow beards.
Do not insist on seeking instruction until higher knowledge has arisen in you. When your heart has the strength to bear the instruction, the instruction will be ready.
Mahatma is one who knows knowledge and conquers the mind, but speaks words of ignorance.
Enjoy the beauty, that's all! If you hope to experience them, then you will face difficulties.
One can destroy the body and extract the life from it, but no human being can make a body and fill it with life.
It is not possible to free the life from the poisonous cycle of things until the real Self-knowledge is realized.
Stop the thought waves that arise in you without control, and only then can you attain the transcendental self-consciousness.
That is not a hindrance to self-realization.
Under the guise of religious differences, they can develop a sense of superiority and climb to the top of the soul.
All religions are born of consent, but the religion that upholds the mind is supreme.
All religions are at a dead end. Everything above that is draining.
A seed sown in fertile soil, a knowledge sown in the heart of a righteous man, bears fruit.
Ignorant animals live in feeding, sleeping and mating activities. What is the difference between a human being and a very knowledgeable person doing the same?
A true Karma Yogi is one who subdues the ego and abandons the body to duty.
Illusion is the fisherman who catches the life of the fish in the basket of Karma, hoping to get rid of the bait which is the pleasure of the soul.
The living being is being punished in the prison of nature for the fault of karma. When the soul is free from karma, it gets the release of salvation.
Based on the axis, the wheels of karma are moving, based on the soul, as the wheel moves.
Don't get beaten up to show God. Let go of karma and appear in moments. Then you are God.
Gurudev commands qualities, Dharajiva acts under the command of qualities.
To realize God who is transcendental, it is possible only if you are also transcendental.
The life that is drifting in the quicksand of qualities! Receive self-knowledge that will pull you out.
Life is surviving with the help of the natural body caused by the power of God! Don't think there is no God.
All beauty is nature, but without the Supreme Spirit they do not shine.
Investigate Nature with Enlightenment! One can perceive the essence of God in nature itself.
Birthlessness is Advaita Siddhi. Mayasiddhi is with thought.
The practice of asanas can lead to physical health. Selfishness does not exist. They are health asanas but not yoga asanas.
Are you saddened by the sight of disabled creatures? How many sins have they committed in their previous lives! Now they are being punished.
Do you think that we will know God in old age! Self-awareness does not stick to a mind that is tangled in the entanglements of worries.
One has to climb three steps to enter the house of salvation. They are 1) Bhakti 2) Knowledge 3) Yoga or Prarabdha, Agami and Sanchita karmas.
Bhakti leads to knowledge, knowledge leads to yoga, yoga leads to Tattva, and Tattva leads to liberation.
What is divine wisdom? To know the spiritual things (dharmas).
Yajna performed externally with fire burns firewood, Yajna performed internally with fire of knowledge burns karmas.
Without karma not even an eyelid can move. No karma comes without ego.
The forces of nature prevail inside and outside to make the life experience the hardships and pleasures in action.
All actions done by a living being with ego have two types of results, namely 1) gross fruit 2) subtle fruit.
A living being experiences gross wealth (karma) in previous births in this birth. He will experience the fruits of this birth in subsequent births.
What a living being acquires is sin and virtue. What is experienced is sorrow and happiness.
Good or bad, if they do deeds without hope of their results, their karma is not like that of living beings.
Sacrifice the soul with cattle and knowledge with the sword, then the soul will bestow the boon of avyayanadam.
The actions of Eajagat are the show of magic that God is giving to the Panchabhutas through the instruments of Maya, which is causing all the difficulties in the hope of happiness.
Intellect with intrigues, mind with deliberations, will with decisions, ego incessantly glorifying the living being.
With fasts and fasts, Jiva! They cannot lift you up. You can achieve the unexpected with yoga.
Those who conquer Maya are great, but not those who speak words associated with Maya.
The difference between austerity and aspiration is the time difference, austerity is a big desire and aspiration is a small desire.
Tattva can be seen only when the strivings and austerities are abandoned.
If you make a habit of focusing your mind on one thing, then it will be very difficult to turn it away from that thing.
The roots of the tree of things are the base of the mind. If the roots are cut, the mind collapses like a tree collapses if things are condemned.
If you are fulfilling one desire, ten desires arise in you, when will you get more desires?
As the lives of ignorant beings are dying out, hopes are rising.
A true ascetic is one who renounces association within, rather than one who renounces external things.
Whenever you desire to know knowledge, try it at that very moment. Because the mind is fickle. Life is volatile.
Remembrance without wills realizes the soul within you of God.
As long as you know yourself, you cannot know the Parabrahman outside of you. Parabrahma is known only after the karma is over and you leave your body.

Life is living in the forest of ignorance full of poisonous plants! That's why you destroy the spiritual weapon one by one and that wilderness, only then you will settle in the plains of the almighty Parabrahma.
They keep you far away from self-knowledge.
It is ignorant to think that karmas that bring comfort are one's involvement and karmas that cause suffering are divine involvement.
All parts of your body say mine, but you do not know who you are.
God does not exist when there is poverty, He comes to mind only when there is deprivation.
Jagannath, who filled the whole world, emerged from God and became God. He is the Ambassador, the Awadhuta.
The shape of the statue in the rock is the symbol of the soul in the hearts of the devotees.
Those who desire Ashtasiddhas will not receive Achalasiddhis.
The real delusional people are those who see delusional people.
As much as a strong boat is needed to cross a river, a pure boat of knowledge is needed to cross a river.
Sadhguru is the sailor who can take life in a boat made of wood with knowledge, cross the ocean of everything, and reach the shore of salvation.
There is only one medicine that has the power to free the life from the poison of materialism, and that medicine is Sadguru Prabodhamrita.
Asha is possessed by a demon and is suffering from peace of mind! If you want to leave it, Guruprabodhana mantra is the refuge.
Absolute knowledge is without doubt.
The living soul, which is not related to both nature and soul, can become divine.
The real purpose of Dipradhan is to put Karma oil in the body and light the lamp of knowledge and knowledge in it and see the soul in that light.
Time is the basis for the living being to experience karma.
Time solves all problems. Living beings have to wait until that time comes.
Being indifferent to the youthful beauty of women, Bondedi creatures are not able to understand that the beauty is the vitality in those bodies.
Living beings who love and enjoy the eternal bodies will suffer when they perish. The soul underlying those bodies is eternal. If you recognize it, there is no real sorrow!
Lust covers knowledge like a cloud covers the sun. As the sun shines when a cloud is dispersed by the waves of air, wisdom shines only when passion is dispersed by the waves of instruction.
Guru tests you to show you the wisdom in you.
Don't burn when the time is up. When Karma is done, life is destroyed.
Just as those who wear shoes can walk fearlessly on the muddy path, so those who wear the shields of wisdom can walk boldly on the path of danger.
Even if the poisoned arrows hit the things of the Arishad Varga, they cannot do anything to the living being who wears the armor of knowledge.
A human being can lead a pure life when he has given up materialistic thinking and grasped the transcendental thinking.
If you know yourself, you will know what your ego is.
Whether you think good or bad, whatever happens will happen.
Do not think that after experiencing all the pleasures, you can get yogic siddhi, then you may get sick.
Every living being has devotion. It is better if it is not devotion to nature but devotion to God.
Temples are not the cause of Kamyartha Pujas. Aryans built temples for Atmartha and Maryu.
The life of a man without wisdom, the beauty of a flower without fragrance is of no use.
The turbans on the head will be removed if you worship God, but will they be removed if you worship God?
Just as camphor is dissolved into nothingness without camphor and fire after burning by fire, so knowledge is burnt by fire and after burning karma and burning knowledge both dissolve in Paramatma.
Aim for your life until you reach the state of self.
Contemplate the Supreme Being who is united in the five parts of nature with different forms, and then the ignorance within you will flee away from you.
Your body is a woman, you are a man in it, your body is becoming conscious due to the union of the two of you.
Self-instruction without experience is like beauty without charm.
Hell and heaven are all in Naraloka. The place where the living being is suffering is hell according to him. The place where the living being feels comfortable is the paradise of God.
Karmajiti is the real independent.
Wealth, strength, and life that are not used for self-knowledge are as wasted as the gold in the city.
The things of the world are first nectar and eventually poison. At first it was like poison and at the end it was like nectar.
Ignorance is the same as the sunrise and darkness. It goes away with enlightenment.
A sadhana without knowledge is like a walk without knowing the path.
It is Maya that fetters the desire of a wife, crushes the desire of a son, binds the life in the prison of nature itself, and experiences the punishment of Karma.
Do you know where the mind is? It is not in one place in the body like you. Awakening is spread throughout the body.
It is the soul that acts as the basis of karma, the body that does it, and the soul that experiences it.
Every person in the world is worshiping hardships with the hope of getting happiness.
This world is the form of birth and death of living souls reflected in the mirror called Maya.
Man, who strives to subjugate the powerful forces of nature, is bound to be disturbed by the forces of nature itself.
There is one power of ignorance that can end the memory of what all names are based on. That is your death.
I think you will be yourself. If I think, you are everywhere says Paramatma.
Ignorant people do karma for samsara. The wise do whatever is done for the sake of karma.
He is different from birth to birth. Each person's karma is different. Mind is different from Karma Karma. Mind is different from mind.
Both knowledge and ignorance are within you. But knowledge is wrapped in the bag of ignorance.
We should be for God's service. But there should be no god for our benefit.
Fruitful action is bonding. Fruitless action is liberating.
From the mother's womb, the Self, and from the womb of Brahma, Prakriti emerged.
In every physical body, there are two divine men. They are literalists.
The fruit of male and female union is the physical cause. The fruit of sinful union is life.
Your body was born for you to experience your karma but you were not born for your body to experience karma.
If you know what karma is, you can be liberated from karma. If you know what the mind is, you can conquer the mind. If you know what the soul is, you can reach the soul.
You think that all things are done according to your will. It is true that your will is due to karma.
The real punishment for living beings is not to attain self-knowledge.
Self-knowledge is the fire that burns all karmas, Self-knowledge is the medicine that heals karma, Self-knowledge is the pure water that washes away the impurities of karma.
Pleasures are like sweet poisons, which are sweet when tasted but produce worst results afterwards.
If you donate for virtue, you will be born for happiness.
In the Bhagavad Gita, the Lord and the Supreme Being said that it is not possible to know God through the four methods of charity, yajna, recitation of the Vedas, and penance.
Indriyagocharan should be recognized as Indriyati.
The one who knows the knowledge knows the ignorance in us.
A body is like a house to a man.
Just like the body and the festival changes, the body also changes in youth, adolescence and old age.
Just like the leaves of a tree change color, your body also changes color in old age.
You are a prisoner in the third place of consciousness, sleep and sleep.
You are wrapped between the three garments of gross, subtle and causal.
Apart from Atma Yogasadhana, other Vratas, tapas, Vedic recitation and other practices are not known.
Knowing the soul alone is not liberation. Salvation is only after the destruction of karma.
Ego is the cause of karma-free and karma-sahita.
Each of us is the cause of the qualityless and the qualityful.
God is material, Paramatma is formless.
Action is due to quality, every quality is due to action, action is due to action. Thus the living being revolves in the cycle of birth and death.
The mind in you is the memory of the things of the senses.
Those who do not know how life enters the body do not know how life leaves the body.
As long as he is in the body, he cannot know the supreme soul.
Don't think of nature's actions as swadharma, know that soul's actions are swadharma.
There are two types of sins, forgivable sins and unforgivable sins.
Even if Lingamaka is the same, it is of three types. Even if it is a limb, it is five ways.
Sons are born of the Father's body. Those who are made with the knowledge of the Guru are sons of knowledge.
I am for the works, but the karma for the works. Karma is the cause of everything.
Dharmartha Kama Moksha is false. Kamartha Dharmamoksha is the truth. It is false that salvation comes from the lust for money due to dharma.
Salvation is obtained by virtue, wealth is obtained by lust.
Every movement in your body is according to karma even if it is soul.
The soul is not outside. Realize that it is in the body.
Realize that what remains in the body in which the soul and living souls are gone at death is the Supreme Spirit.
It is called "Dhanamula Midam Jagat". Karma is also the cause of that money, so the saying Karmula Midam Jagat is true and correct.
Just as a mother knows who is the father of a child, only the Guru knows who is God to a living being.
Physical health is due to food and mental health is due to food.
Food is not the cause of qualities. Know that qualities are the cause of food.
Do not think that there is another world due to ignorance. All the worlds are in your head.
You cannot identify the snake in the mound just by looking at the mound. Just by looking at the body, one cannot recognize the living soul in the body.
Just as the candle is extinguished when the oil is exhausted in the body, the soul is extinguished when the karma is exhausted in the body.
Prarabdhakarma is the act of causing the will to the living being, making it act according to their thoughts, and subjecting it to feelings of pleasure and pain from time to time.
Even if you are tempted, you will not get the fruit beyond your karma.
There are two ways to fulfill the karma of beings. Whether to experience it or burn it to the fire of knowledge.
Your body is nature separate from you.
As long as you consider the nature (body) separate from you as you, your ignorance will not disappear.
If Karma is not fulfilled, you are Kaya, and if Karma is fulfilled, you are Kaala.
The mind is like a bird that sleeps in its nest at night and roams for pasture during the day. In sushupti, the soul sleeps in a hole called Atma and when it wakes up, it wanders into things.
The soul is your friend, but you have turned it into an enemy through ignorance. Nature is your enemy, but ignorance is your friend.
Giving rice to the hungry, teaching self-knowledge to the unwilling is a useless task.
If you stay away from things, Visvesvara will come closer to you.
Do not worship yourself with pride. Abandoning the ego and worshiping the Atman can include the Supreme.
Find out what your body is doing and what you are doing! That is pride.
Relate to everything, but not to ego.
Each of the qualities is as strong as an elephant, but it rustles at the threshold of knowledge.
The Prakriti (qualities) which you do not see from your body are inextricably linked with the Prakriti which you see outside the body. The result of their conflict is what makes you happy.
You are earning investment karma for the money wise. You will be able to acquire knowledge for the karmayagnani.
All living beings are palakshus, but only some living beings have that eye sight.
Remember that virtues are in your eyes and deeds of virtues are in your eyes.
If pride causes you karma, that karma causes happiness and sorrow. If Guruseva gives you knowledge, that knowledge will remove your karma.
Know how Karma arises and how it is removed is easy to know.
Hopes shake your memory.
You have nothing to gain from knowing the future. What happens happens whether you know it or not.
Invite your omen of failure to success.
The Mahatma is the one who conquers even though the body does not move but the mind does not move. He who moves the mind without moving the body is Mandatma.
The serpent of delusion and poison is biting you. Know that the right medicine for that matter is self-knowledge.
If you look at nature with lustless eyes, it will be tempted by you. Viewing nature through lustful eyes will only hurt you.
Hope is the great power that sacrifices your satisfaction without you knowing it.
Your life is being wasted in expecting to satisfy hope. But it is not satisfying.
To fulfill the desire, it is possible only with self-efficacy but not with anything else.
Hope is bigger than the sky if there is a chance.
Wanted in this life! It is enough in another birth!
Fighting between illusion and mind and defeating illusion by the mind is a yoga practice that a human being should do.
There are two paths in man's journey of life. One of them (Prakritimarga) is Mayamarga, and the second is the divine path (Paramatmamarga).
Grasp the good and discard the bad in a story.
Among the knowledge and ignorance in a man, grasp the knowledge and discard the ignorance.
Don't believe everything that man says is true, know that everything that God says is true!
Just as there are friends and enemies on earth, in the body the life has two types of friends and enemies.

Just as salt is opposite to sour, sweet to bitter, so charity to lust, kindness to anger, generosity to greed, dispassion to lust, humility to religion, and love to jealousy are opposites in the body.
Just as salt dissolves in water and does not know, Maya is present in the body.
Just as command is accompanied by authority, instruction is accompanied by non-authority.
Just as sight can see the country, so knowledge can know the place of instruction.
The eye can see, so the intellect can see.
A disease needs a medicine, a disease needs a divine medicine.
Medicine consists of things, while divine medicine consists of knowledge.
Disease is for the body, pain is for the soul, groaning is for the soul, neutrality is for the supreme soul.
A real sage is one who knows that just as the body of a big elephant contains life, soul and spirit, so also the smallest ant has life, soul and spirit.
Like water to a lemon, the branch does not suck. Also man does not like knowledge like ignorance.
Earthworms come out only when it rains. Only frogs come out of water. Only the curious emerge for knowledge.
Knowledge is visible to the eye of knowledge as it is visible to the eye.
Beware of the evil of the teachers on earth!
What God says is God's wisdom. What men say is not divine wisdom.
Maya is manifested in the world as God.
God is manifested in the world as Maya.
It is natural that Maya appears as God and God as Maya in the world.
There is something magical in the world and great knowledge is needed to know who God is.
Even though God appears as illusion, ultimately he teaches divine knowledge. Even though Maya looks like God, he teaches us to follow his own way to finally let go of God's way.
God did not create religions and castes.
God alone created Maya and humans.
He who is called in many ways, by many names, and differently according to religions is one God.
The Lord of the universe, the creator of the universe, and the originator of the universe is one God.
God has no name or form.
God has to tell His own story, and others do not know His story.
God is called God when he comes to earth to make his point known. God has a form of name.
Superstition and superstition belong to the same species.
Belief is like health to man, but superstition is like disease to man.
You and your father have faith, but neither you nor you are superstitious.
Science is belief, mythology is superstition.
Scientific belief never wavers. A superstition that is not rational is never true.
Worshiping God is not faith, but worshiping minor gods is superstition.
Beliefs may or may not exist. But there are no superstitions.
There is faith in astrology and superstition in astrology.
Do not serve ignorant people, in serving the wise, wisdom is available for life.
The mind has form, but its function is unlimited.
Lochana means eye. The inner eye is called thought.
Both outer eyes show one scene together. The two inner eyes do not meet.
Humans are born with two eyes and can develop two eyes.
The inner eyes are two distinct. One shows worldly things. The second will show the matter of God. The first is Manonetra and the second is Gnananetra.
Every living being has three eyes due to karma, but one eye due to attention is the eye of knowledge.
When the human eye opens, the intellectual eye closes. When the cognitive eye opens, the mental eye closes.
A human being cannot easily distinguish which is the eye of knowledge and which is the eye of mind.
Gnananetra and Manonetra both work for God only at the same time.
There is the best knowledge and the best ignorance in the country. What you want is what you get.
There are many teachers in the country. All teachers look like teachers. However, there is only one teacher in the country.
There are teachers in the country from paisa level to 99 paisa level as one rupee is a hundred paisa. 100 paisa (rupee) level.
It is very difficult to find a teacher. Because from the level of one paisa to 99 paisa, it appears.
It is natural that teachers look like teachers and teachers look like teachers. However, a teacher is a teacher and a teacher is a teacher!
As God is the real Guru, the Guru is sometimes physical and sometimes immaterial.
Only God, the real Guru, is the Jagadguru in the world. He who has many disciples is not a Jagadguru.
Jagadguru is the one who conveys knowledge applicable to all beings in the world.
Lord Jagadguru is born not by father's semen but by his will.
God may have a mother on earth, but no father.
God is the Supreme Representative. God is real. Paramatma is formless.
It is not possible to know Paramatma (God) through God in the world.
No other human can know God except God.
Since God is the aspect of God (Paramatma), God alone knows the matter of God.
Who knows when, where, how and in what form God will be born on earth. Therefore people see his avatar differently.

God who becomes a human being can be a beggar in one life and a rich person in another life. Also, one may be a celibate in one birth and a luxurious man with many wives in another. At least many are unable to recognize God.
When God came to earth as a human being, the sages who did not recognize Him said the same words that the same God had said in the previous birth and counted Him as inferior to them.
Those who believed in God's words in the past, not knowing the correct meaning of those words, are unable to recognize Him when He comes the second time.

It is ignorance to think that salvation heaven is one place, one vast building, without knowing that when the living being reaches God, it is the union of life and the divine, and that it pervades all.
One who has joined God is not separate from God. So they don't have a place, a village, a house.
He who is joined to God is God himself, and himself is God spread wide and atom by atom.
Maya (Saitan) or Satan deceives man in the name of religion.
Religion does not know God. Knowledge is God.
God is not monotheistic.
It is ignorance to imagine God as a religion and limit God to religion. Wisdom is knowing that the head of all religions is one God.
Whenever God comes to earth, He comes as God. That means he comes in male form and not in female form.
It should be known that in men and women, the woman should be connected to nature and the man should be connected to the Supreme Spirit.
If God comes to earth as God, nature also takes male birth and believes that He is God.
They are careful not to know that God and nature have come to earth.
God who came to earth does not claim to be God. Similarly, nature does not say that it is Maya.
Those who do not fully know the knowledge of God compare God as a common man and Maya as God.
Although the organism born on earth is a spirit element, it has the characteristics of nature.
Although Jivatma is an aspect of Purusha, there is impotence which is the aspect of nature.
There are three types of souls and five types of nature in the body.
The living body is formed by the combination of three souls called Paramatma, Atma and Jivatma and five elements called sky, air, fire, water and earth.
While the body is the five types of instruments, while the soul works using the instruments, the Supreme Spirit sees and the living soul experiences.

The visible parts of the body, the invisible qualities, the mind, the intellect, the mind, and the ego are all many parts and are born of nature, but those born of the Supreme Spirit can only have two, the soul and the soul!

While the soul that pervades the body and does all the work is on the screen, no one knows what it is, the living soul that resides in one place in the body does not know what it is doing, it appears on the screen as if it knows everything.

While the whole body is nature, and in the body there is the Supreme Spirit, and there is a soul that is the role holder at all times, the living soul, which is not the role holder, is deluded that the whole body is the body, and cannot know the soul or the nature behind it.

While the soul in the body is always awake and working without resting even for a single moment, the living soul sees and experiences what is happening for a while and is still for a while without seeing. We say that the time you see and experience is awake, and the time you don't see is called sleep.
While the living soul in the body is blind to all kinds of things, the five sense organs inform him of all things.
The living soul, which does not know its true state in the body, is immersed in the illusion that it knows everything and does everything by itself.
Paramatma, Atma and Jivatma are illusory in successive order, whether Jivatma is the last or the first.
In the hand of every human being, the lines of the spirit soul are united, and above the two lines of the supreme soul are imprinted in the womb.
The supreme soul can pervade the entire universe, the soul body, and the needle tip in the forehead of the living soul's head.
Atma Jivatmans are two pairs of souls. There can be no soul without soul, no soul without soul.
There is as much life as a needle in the body, but the Supreme Soul is pervading the entire universe without a trace.
The living soul has only one form, the soul has many forms, the supreme soul has no form.
The spirit soul has place, form, name and function, but the supreme soul has none.

There are six qualities spread on earth. We call them the six enemies (Arishat Varga). There are six other non-promotional qualities and they are called the Six Mitragumpu (Maitri Shut Varga). Who does not know about the qualities of Maitrishat Varga. We ourselves (Sri Sri Acharya Prabodhanandayogeeswaru) said them first.
Gunas are six in hostile and six in friendly, totaling twelve. Their image is illusion.

When a woman is unmarried, she has two husbands. After marriage there will be three husbands. Therefore it can be said that a woman has one visible husband and two invisible husbands.
The qualities of the body are different and the soul is different. Atman is known only when the Jiva gives up the attributes.
Atman cannot be known by any quality. Therefore, the quality of love, the quality of mercy, and the quality of charity are useless for self-knowledge.
Many consider ego to be a quality. But ego is not a quality. Ego is a part of the body.

Gunas are not parts of the body. In the body itself there is a body beyond the body, Brahma Kala, Karma, and Guna Chakras, which are not in the body, are found in the lower Guna Chakra in the group of four chakras.
The non-bodily qualities are 36 in total, the antahkaranas in the body are four, of which the ego is one.
Karma Yoga arises from the internal parts of the body, ego from the mind, Brahma Yoga from the mind, and Bhakti Yoga from the intellect.
God has no mercy. No mercy and no quality.
God has no love. Not jealous. But likes and dislikes.
Many people think that liking is love. But love is different from liking.
Lust and lust are considered to be the same thing. But lust is different, infatuation is different.
Praising a god is thought of as devotion and wisdom. But it may be devotion, but not knowledge at all.
Singing about some deity or God becomes a kirtan. Chanting and meditation are different.
One's glorification is known to outsiders. Meditation is known only to the inner soul.
Low and high depends on the mind of the person. As high as a spinach is to a pig, it is low to a man.
If the wisdom of God appears superior to one intellect, the wisdom of God appears inferior to the intellect of another, and the knowledge of the world is exalted.
When the mind inside changes, the outside can become noble. Then the knowledge that seemed so low to man will become high.
If the knowledge that you speak seems to be low to another, it should be understood that it is in his mind.
Hunger is satisfied with rice. Karma is performed with knowledge.

Calling science a myth, calling a myth a science is like calling an elephant a mouse and a mouse an elephant.
Good is not bad as long as you don't have enough. Also evil is not good as much as you like it.

Everything that comes to you comes due to karma. Everything you have is due to karma. Everything you lost is due to karma.
Do you know if your caste is true or not? Has anything changed in the middle!
Do you really know if mine is your religion? Has anything changed in the middle!
Unbeknownst to you, you are in a religion that never changes, a caste that never changes.

Your gotra is always nature. Your last name is Karma forever.
He who has no family name is the real Father God.

How many trees must be blown by the wind. No amount of karma is necessary.
Just as any wise person does not suffer from emotional pain, any deity does not suffer from hardships and sufferings.
As among men there are rich and poor, so among gods there are rich and poor.

It should be known that whoever comes from hardships to happiness or goes from happiness to hardships, it is not due to his intellect, but due to his karma.

If imagination is born by the soul, thought is born by the mind.

Who does not know where the ego starts and works. Therefore the ego can be considered as a black crow.

Living to eat, eating to live is not life.

God does not have one form. God is without sleep, wakefulness, hunger and thirst. God is the all-pervasive, ever-present, all-seeing. Know that God.
